{{Quote|Go and meet Odoof Grunda and bring his painting back to me. I want to have it up for the opening ceremony of the Arts Gala.|Jaleela Bindoo|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Jaleela Bindoo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]] on [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], she planned to participate in the [[Narmle Arts Gala]]. During the opening ceremony of the event, she planned to display a painting that was made by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Artist/Legends|artist]] [[Odoof Grunda]], so she hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to collect the work from Grunda.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Jaleela Bindoo was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
